basic_details.job_title: Uttara Kannada Zilla Panchayat Assistant District Project Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Uttara Kannada Zilla Panchayat (Uttara Kannada Jilla Panchayat), Karwar needs 1 Assistant District Project Manager (Sahayaka Jilla Yojana Vyavasthapakaru) for the e-Panchayat programme of the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan scheme, engaged on outsourcing basis at a monthly honorarium of Rs. 30,000/- (service charge + service tax separate). Candidates with BE (C.S/E&C/I.S) /MCA/ BCA can apply online on https://zpuk.karnataka.gov.in/ from 23 November 2026, 10:00 AM until 30 November 2026, 05:30 PM.

how_to_apply: Open the website of the Chief Executive Officer, Uttara Kannada Zilla Panchayat, Karwar: https://zpuk.karnataka.gov.in/ (the notice also names the recruitment link https://zpuk.karnataka.gov.in/39/recruitment).
Fill in the prescribed online application form.
Submit the application between 10:00 AM on 23 November 2026 and 05:30 PM on 30 November 2026.
Applications received after 05:30 PM on 30 November 2026 will not be considered. The notice does not list any documents to attach.
important_instructions: The services of the Assistant District Project Manager will be obtained on outsourcing basis. Service charge and service tax are separate from the monthly honorarium of Rs. 30,000/-. Applications received after the closing time on 30 November 2026 will not be considered. For more information, the notice gives the phone number 9902447780. The Zilla Panchayat letterhead gives telephone numbers 226560 and 226246, fax 226470 and email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About Uttara Kannada ZP
content_sections.text: Uttara Kannada Zilla Panchayat is the district panchayat of Uttara Kannada district in Karnataka, with its office at Karwar. The Chief Executive Officer of the Zilla Panchayat issued the notice on 21 November 2026. The post is meant for the effective implementation and monitoring of the progress of the various schemes developed by the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, under the e-Panchayat programme of the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan scheme.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the Assistant District Project Manager post is BE (C.S/E&C/I.S) /MCA/ BCA , as printed in the notice. Any one of these qualifications is listed for the post. The notice does not mention any experience, desirable qualification or age limit for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Uttara Kannada ZP Assistant District Project Manager
content_sections.text: Open the website of the Chief Executive Officer, Uttara Kannada Zilla Panchayat, Karwar: https://zpuk.karnataka.gov.in/ (the notice also names the recruitment link https://zpuk.karnataka.gov.in/39/recruitment ). Fill in the prescribed online application form. Submit the application between 10:00 AM on 23 November 2026 and 05:30 PM on 30 November 2026. Applications received after 05:30 PM on 30 November 2026 will not be considered. The notice does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 22 November 2026, the online application window has not yet opened. It opens on 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The services of the Assistant District Project Manager will be obtained on outsourcing basis. Service charge and service tax are separate from the monthly honorarium of Rs. 30,000/-. Applications received after the closing time on 30 November 2026 will not be considered. For more information, the notice gives the phone number 9902447780. The Zilla Panchayat letterhead gives telephone numbers 226560 and 226246, fax 226470 and email [email protected] .
